champion.tips: ZAAHEN TIPS AND TRICKS Get as many stacks on your Passive as possible and then play aggressively, as you’re much stronger than most enemy champions. Zaahen’s level 1 is extremely strong, especially with a few stacks on your Passive and your Q up. Look for an aggressive play early to gain a lead. Zaahen is a strong all-in champion who loves extended trades. Keep the wave closer to your side of the map so you can all-in and chase the enemy down the lane.
champion.builds: THE BEST ZAAHEN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Zaahen Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Trinity Force as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Sundered Sky. For your last 3 items, you should build Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance and finish with Overlord's Bloodmail. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 55.7% winrate over 39 191 matches played. Optional Your second option for Zaahen Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Stridebreaker, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Sundered Sky as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage and Overlord's Bloodmail. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 56.0% win rate over 21 887 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Sundered Sky as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Spear of Shojin as a third item. You want to finish the build with Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage and Overlord's Bloodmail. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 56.1% win rate across 3 854 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Zaahen Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Black Cleaver as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Sundered Sky as third item. The last 3 options are Overlord's Bloodmail, Sterak's Gage and Death's Dance. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 56.9% win rate over 3 791 matches played. Situational Zaahen Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Zaahen build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against.
